method: Configured Bazel cquery; keep Wasm platform rust_library/rust_cdylib_library targets; read the exact patched Cargo.toml and selected actual license/source files. No source or build configuration was changed.
limitations: Conservative configured dependency closure, not post-link byte-level attribution.
Rust std/runtime and embedded third-party source/data are described separately, not included in crate counts.
Font files, JS/npm dependencies, workerd itself, Public Suffix List text modules and DevTools frontend are outside this Wasm-focused inventory.
This is a technical license inventory and redistribution gap analysis, not a complete legal clearance.

supplemental_licenses.qualification: Embedded at source level; individual profile retention after LTO/dead-code removal is not proven.

supplemental_licenses.license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 for std; compiler-builtins contains MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; libm MIT and per-file notices
supplemental_licenses.qualification: Not enumerated in the 310 external-crate count. Full target-specific std runtime audit remains separate.

findings.finding: 11 MPL-2.0-only runtime crates are configured for core; stylo and selectors have Kitesurf patches.
findings.action: Give recipients an explicit source-availability notice for the exact patched MPL-covered sources, preserving MPL and source notices. A pointer to pristine registry sources alone is insufficient for patched files.

findings.finding: encoding_rs has (Apache-2.0 OR MIT) AND BSD-3-Clause. Its WHATWG copyright/license is absent from the currently shipped text notices.
findings.action: Include encoding_rs LICENSE-WHATWG and the selected base license/required notices.

findings.finding: The current dist/licenses includes upstream root notices and select supplemental texts, not a per-crate third-party notice set for all Wasm dependencies. Missing examples include Unicode-3.0, icy_sixel MIT copyright, and several Zlib/BSD copyright notices. Cargo.lock is metadata, not license text.
findings.action: Generate and distribute target-specific third-party notices with correct copyright and full relevant texts; preserve AND terms and any chosen OR alternatives.

findings.finding: jpeg-encoder is (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND IJG in all three build graphs. Existing Kitesurf-NOTICE already includes the required Independent JPEG Group acknowledgement and dist/licenses includes the IJG text.
findings.action: Retain that acknowledgement and the applicable license texts.

findings.finding: icy_sixel@0.1.3 omits license metadata; LICENSE is MIT and its SHA-256 matches the explicit upstream clarification.
findings.action: Treat as MIT only with this file-level evidence and retain its copyright notice.

findings.finding: The inventory is the configured Wasm-target Rust dependency closure, not a function-level proof that every crate contributes bytes after LTO. Host build/proc-macro dependencies are excluded from the count.
findings.action: Use this conservative inventory for notice preparation; audit build-generated code and std runtime separately before claiming exhaustive binary coverage.

findings.finding: No GPL/LGPL/AGPL-only declaration appears in the reviewed target crate metadata; this is not a whole-source or binary legal clearance.
findings.action: Do not infer that metadata review alone establishes complete redistribution compliance.

license_clarification.reason: Cargo.toml omits license; full MIT text matches upstream .config/about.toml clarification.
